name: rama
description: RAMA: a ghost-writing workflow for novels built from a synopsis, outline, style guide and story bible. config sets up and checks the project, beats plans a chapter, compose writes it to the style guide, check enforces style, outline and continuity, and compile builds .md/.docx/.epub with glyphs. Every question is asked as a three-option survey with a write-in. Includes adapted ghost-writer editorial tools (demolish, review, integrate, retune, freeflow, characters, corrections).
